page_title: Karakol Ski Transfer — transfers to Karakol ski resorts
meta_description: Private and shared transfers with a driver from Karakol to Karakol Ski Resort, Kapriz and Ala-Too. Door-to-door pickup, up to 6 passengers, roof box, fixed rates.
hero_title: Reach the snow without the hassle
hero_subtitle: Transfers with a driver to Karakol ski resorts. We pick you up at your address, wait up to 4 hours on the slope and bring you back.
loc_subtitle: Choose your destination. The price is fixed: per vehicle or per person.
loc1_desc: Karakol's main ski resort and the neighbouring Kapriz. Easy access to the slopes, rentals and cafes on site.
loc2_desc: A scenic resort in the Ala-Too mountains, great for relaxed skiing and family trips.
cars_subtitle: Prepared 4x4 vehicles with a roof box — skis and snowboards fit with no trouble.
prices_subtitle: Fixed prices in KGS. Pay the driver on site.
note1: Up to 4 hours of waiting are included. Longer waiting is by arrangement and may cost extra.
note2: Shared trips to Ala-Too depart with at least 3 passengers. If the group doesn't fill up — reschedule, refund or a private transfer with a surcharge.
note3: We pick clients up at their addresses. For shared trips — up to 3 pickup points, then we drive to Karakol.
note4: The price is for a transfer, not car rental. The driver is included.
how_subtitle: From your address to the slope and back.
step1_d: Message us on WhatsApp: date, address, resort, number of passengers and transfer type.
step2_d: We agree on the time, driver and final price. No prepayment.
step3_d: The driver comes to you. For shared trips — up to 3 pickup points.
step4_d: We take you to the resort, wait up to 4 hours and drive you back to your address.
how_note: Skis, snowboards and luggage go in the roof box.
book_subtitle: Fill in the request — WhatsApp will open with a ready message.
form_hint: We'll confirm the final price and time in chat.
contact_subtitle: We'll answer your questions and book your transfer.
contact_quick_desc: Message us on WhatsApp or Telegram — we'll share available times and confirm your booking.
